name: Wanderlust
reason: Out of scope: the channel (Data API, 10 Nov 2026; 132,000 subscribers) belongs to Wanderlust, a wellness-events and supplements business. Its latest 25 uploads are mostly festival promos, celebrity event trailers (Jay Shetty, Pamela Anderson), 'BIOHACK' adverts and fitness-style vinyasa and mobility flows by guest teachers; its own description promotes plant-based supplements. Mainly business/fitness, not its own contemplative teaching. No site fetched.
